changelog:
Async concurrency restored for parallel style transfers and video edits.

Features:
  - Restore true async concurrency in concurrent command using AsyncClient
    with asyncio.Semaphore (capped at 4 parallel requests) (#6)
  - Add _save_async_image() helper with proper await for async .image property
  - Apply same Semaphore + async-with pattern to video-concurrent command

Docs:
  - Add multi-turn chaining note clarifying unlimited --prompt steps on a
    single source image (#5)
